frame_image_note: Video co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) dau video, quet tu trai sang phai, quet xong hoan toan khoang frame ~20/129 (f18 van con thay vet quet sang, f20 da sach khong con vet). Khoi trang da bat dau hien ngay trong luc quet (tu f9) va den f20 thi bo cuc 'ao + khoi bao quanh' da day du va on dinh. Chon frame 20 lam anh goc: sach vet quet, bo cuc day du, va la thoi diem som nhat truoc khi hau canh bat dau mo/nhoe dan them o cac khung sau (tu ~f45 tro di nen ngay cang blur).
effect_prompt: Thick white smoke billows and swirls dynamically around the product, with wisps drifting close to the camera and creating a soft, shallow depth-of-field blur that gradually intensifies in the background over time as the smoke thins and settles into a soft hazy glow. The camera remains completely fixed, with the product hanging centered and motionless throughout. Plain dark studio background, soft diffused lighting, moody minimal atmosphere.
effect_prompt_note: Quan sat f0/5/9/13 (truoc va trong luc quet sang) va f20/30/45/60/75/90/105/120 (129 khung/24fps, cung ho nhu smoky-pedestal/water-electric-hues). Wipe quet trai->phai xong o ~f20, luc do khoi da bao quanh san pham day du. Tu f45 tro di, khoi hau canh ngay cang mo/nhoe (giam chi tiet, tang do blur/bokeh) nhung mat do khoi va vi tri san pham khong doi qua cac khung -- giong khoi loang/tan dan thanh lop suong mo hon la do camera di chuyen. San pham (ao thun) khong xoay, khong doi vi tri hay kich thuoc qua cac khung -> camera dung yen hoan toan, khong co zoom/dolly/rotate ro ret.
image_prompt: Swirling white smoke in a dark studio surrounds the single product from image 2, floating upright and centered in the same spot where the t-shirt was. The product is about the same size as the t-shirt and fills the same central space. The product keeps the exact shape, proportions, colors, materials, logo and all printed text of image 2. The swirling smoke drifts softly in front of and around the product, with soft highlights catching its surface, matching the lighting of image 1. The dark background and the swirling smoke stay the same as image 1.
image_prompt_note: Viet lai 2026-10 LAN 3 theo cau truc NGUOI DUNG tu phat hien tren dome-product (giay->lon): KHONG dung cau lenh 'Replace' (lan 2, ngan gon, chi hieu qua khi hinh dang vat cu/moi gan giong nhau), ma mo ta TRUC TIEP canh cuoi cung nhu dang ke lai 1 buc anh co san ('X holds the single product from image 2, [tu the cu the]...'). Vat the CU chi duoc nhac 1 LAN DUY NHAT, ngan gon, lam moc vi tri/kich thuoc ('in the spot where the X was', 'about the same size as the X') -- KHONG mo ta hinh dang/chat lieu cua no. Phan lon do dai danh cho: (a) mo ta quan he VAT LY cu the cua san pham moi (dung o dau, de len gi, bong do the nao), (b) mo ta TUONG TAC QUANG HOC giua san pham moi va canh (anh sang/phan chieu/khoi/nuoc cham vao be mat san pham) de model 'tich hop' thay vi 'dan de'. Da test thuc nghiem tren dome-product (giay->lon, ca KHO nhat voi cong thuc Replace don gian): THANH CONG ro ret, lon thay giay hoan toan sach se trong 1 lan chay.
